name: Milford Sound & Fiordland
about: One of the wettest inhabited places on Earth — but that's what feeds the waterfalls. The Milford Road can close for avalanche control in winter, and the Milford Track's huts are only serviced roughly Nov–Apr.
overview: Mitre Peak rising straight out of the water, waterfalls cascading down sheer cliffs — one of the most dramatic fiords on Earth.
costOverview: Even the most basic coach-and-cruise day tour from Te Anau runs well over a hundred dollars, with fly-cruise-fly options costing several times that.

costItems.label: Value coach + cruise day tour from Te Anau

specialSeasons.text: The Milford Road can close temporarily for avalanche control, and the Milford Track's huts are unserviced, making it a real backcountry trip rather than a guided Great Walk.
